cases.q: What flavors of Dole whip are available at Disney World?
cases.answer:
Our menu data lists DOLE Whip in 9 flavors at Walt Disney World (menus read Oct 21): pineapple, orange, lime, strawberry, key lime, mango, peach, raspberry and watermelon.

- **Magic Kingdom:** pineapple and mango at Aloha Isle; orange and strawberry at Sunshine Tree Terrace
- **EPCOT:** Refreshment Outpost (no flavor named)
- **Animal Kingdom:** pineapple at Tamu Tamu Refreshments; pineapple and orange at Warung Outpost
- **Disney Springs:** peach, pineapple and raspberry at Swirls on the Water; pineapple and orange at The Basket at Wine Bar George and Wine Bar George – A Restaurant & Bar
- **Resort hotels:** lime at Barefoot Pool Bar (Polynesian Village) and Oasis Bar & Grill (Polynesian Village); key lime at Good's Food to Go (Old Key West); Pineapple Lanai (Polynesian Village) (no flavor named); 2 more stands
- **Water parks:** orange and pineapple at Leaning Palms (Typhoon Lagoon); strawberry and watermelon at Snack Shack (Typhoon Lagoon)

Older rows also name cherry at Swirls on the Water, but no recent menu read confirms it, so we can't say it is still offered.
